## Type of Change

- [ ] 🍕 Feature - A non-breaking change which adds functionality.
- [ ] 🐛 Bugfix - A non-breaking change which fixes a bug/issue.
- [ ] 🔥 Hotfix - A non-breaking change with a temporary solution and/or without following the usual process (usually because of an emergency)
- [ ] 🔒 Security - A change that addresses a security vulnerability or improves security measures.
- [ ] 👨‍💻 Refactor - A change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature.
- [ ] 📝 Documentation - A change only to in-code or markdown documentation.
- [ ] ✅ Tests - A change that adds missing unit/integration tests.
- [ ] 📦 Chore - A change that is likely none of the above.
